title: Glowing tractor
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <style>
      .tire{fill:#2c2c54}
      .tireIn{fill:#4a4a8a}
      .rim{fill:#f0d840}
      .rimIn{fill:#faf070}
      .body{fill:#e63946}
      .bodyHi{fill:#ff6b75}
      .cab{fill:#f4a261}
      .cabHi{fill:#ffc98f}
      .glass{fill:#a8dadc}
      .pipe{fill:#8d8d8d}
      .seat{fill:#3a3a6a}
    </style>
  </defs>
  <!-- rear big tire -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='70' r='22' class='tire'/>
  <circle cx='38' cy='70' r='14' class='tireIn'/>
  <circle cx='38' cy='70' r='7' class='rim'/>
  <circle cx='38' cy='70' r='3' class='rimIn'/>
  <!-- front small tire -->
  <circle cx='78' cy='76' r='13' class='tire'/>
  <circle cx='78' cy='76' r='8' class='tireIn'/>
  <circle cx='78' cy='76' r='4' class='rim'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <rect x='34' y='52' width='44' height='16' rx='3' class='body'/>
  <rect x='34' y='52' width='44' height='5' rx='2.5' class='bodyHi'/>
  <!-- hood -->
  <rect x='70' y='48' width='22' height='20' rx='4' class='body'/>
  <rect x='70' y='48' width='22' height='5' rx='2.5' class='bodyHi'/>
  <!-- exhaust pipe -->
  <rect x='86' y='38' width='4' height='12' class='pipe'/>
  <circle cx='88' cy='38' r='3' class='pipe'/>
  <!-- cab -->
  <rect x='36' y='26' width='24' height='28' rx='3' class='cab'/>
  <rect x='36' y='26' width='24' height='5' rx='2.5' class='cabHi'/>
  <!-- window -->
  <rect x='40' y='32' width='16' height='13' rx='2' class='glass'/>
  <!-- seat inside -->
  <rect x='44' y='45' width='10' height='6' rx='2' class='seat'/>
  <!-- headlight -->
  <circle cx='90' cy='62' r='3.5' class='rimIn'/>
</svg>
